company_summary.one_line_business.value: Snowflake provides an enterprise data and AI platform that enables organizations to consolidate data, build applications, perform analytics, and develop AI workloads across clouds.

value.summary: Snowflake Cortex AI and Snowpark enable customers to build and operate AI and machine-learning applications directly on governed enterprise data.
